content:
Let  
\[
a=\log_{2026}x \quad\Rightarrow\quad x=2026^a.
\]
Then
\[
\sqrt[20]{x^{\log_{2026}x}}
= \sqrt[20]{x^a}
= x^{a/20}
= (2026^a)^{a/20}
=2026^{a^2/20}.
\]
So the equation becomes
\[
2026^{a^2/20}=26x=26\cdot 2026^a.
\]
Taking \(\log_{2026}\) of both sides,
\[
\frac{a^2}{20}=\log_{2026}26+a,
\]
or
\[
a^2-20a-20\log_{2026}26=0.
\]
This quadratic in \(a\) has two roots, say \(a_1,a_2\), whose sum is \(20\). Therefore the corresponding positive values of \(x\) are
\[
x=2026^{a_1},\quad x=2026^{a_2},
\]
and their product is
\[
2026^{a_1+a_2}=2026^{20}.
\]
Now factor \(2026\):
\[
2026=2\cdot 1013,
\]
so
\[
2026^{20}=2^{20}\cdot 1013^{20}.
\]
Thus the number of positive divisors is
\[
(20+1)(20+1)=21^2=441.
\]

\[
\boxed{441}
\]
